title: Object
spec: Start by creating a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero and a translation vector also set to zero. Next, draw a two-dimensional sketch on the first face. This sketch consists of a single loop made up of twelve lines. The first line starts at the origin (0.0, 0.0) and ends at (0.0227, 0.0). The second line continues from (0.0227, 0.0) to (0.0227, 0.0078), and so on, until the twelfth line completes the loop by returning to the origin. After completing the sketch, apply a scale factor of 0.0227 to the entire two-dimensional sketch. Then, transform the scaled two-dimensional sketch into three-dimensional space by rotating it using Euler angles of zero and translating it with a vector of zero. Finally, extrude the two-dimensional sketch along the normal direction by 0.75 units to create a new solid body. The resulting object is a vertical rod with a cylindrical section at the bottom and a conical tip at the top. The rod has a uniform diameter throughout its length, with a total length of 0.022656249999999992 units, a width of 0.007812499999999998 units, and a height of 0.75 units.

import cadquery as cq

# Create a new workplane
wp = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Define the sketch
sketch = wp.polyline([
    (0.0, 0.0),
    (0.0227, 0.0),
    (0.0227, 0.0078),
    (0.0195, 0.0078),
    (0.0195, 0.0077),
    (0.0225, 0.0077),
    (0.0225, 0.0001),
    (0.0001, 0.0001),
    (0.0001, 0.0077),
    (0.0031, 0.0077),
    (0.0031, 0.0078),
    (0.0, 0.0078),
    (0.0, 0.0)
]).close()

# Extrude the sketch
extruded = sketch.extrude(0.75)

# The final model
r = extruded

lanes.label: GLM-5.3 Flash (high)
lanes.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Channel section: outer 0.0227 (X) x 0.0078 (Y), open slot at +Y side,
# extruded 0.75 along Z
t = 0.002   # wall thickness
W = 0.0227  # outer width along X
D = 0.0078  # outer depth along Y

outer = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .moveTo(0, 0)
    .lineTo(W, 0)
    .lineTo(W, D)
    .lineTo(0, D)
    .close()
)

inner = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .moveTo(t, t)
    .lineTo(W - t, t)
    .lineTo(W - t, D + 0.001)
    .lineTo(t, D + 0.001)
    .close()
)

profile = outer.val().cut(inner.val())

r = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .add(profile)
    .extrude(0.75)
)

import cadquery as cq

# L-shaped (angle) cross-section in the XY plane
# Overall width X = 0.0227, overall depth Y = 0.0078, leg thickness = 0.0013
r = cq.Workplane("XY")

r = r.moveTo(0.0, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.0013, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.0013, 0.0065) \
     .lineTo(0.0227, 0.0065) \
     .lineTo(0.0227, 0.0078) \
     .lineTo(0.0, 0.0078) \
     .close()

# Extrude the angle profile to the full length along Z
r = r.extrude(0.75)

# The final model is represented as 'r'
